meta: Use AI to read and summarize hundreds of customer reviews, so you don't remember only a few harsh complaints and miss what many people say.

muc.title: Three hundred reviews at once
muc.text: Reading three hundred customer reviews by eye, you tend to remember a few harsh complaints and miss what many people say.

muc.title: Delete customer details
muc.text: Before pasting into AI, delete customers' names, phone numbers and order numbers. Keep only the feedback.

muc.title: Group by theme
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to group the feedback by theme, count the comments in each group, and include two verbatim quotes.

muc.title: Double-check the numbers
muc.text: AI can miscount or merge the wrong groups. Recount one group yourself before you report.

muc.title: Twenty comments
muc.text: Paste twenty comments from under your post and ask AI to group them into three main themes.

thu: Paste 20 comments from under your post and ask AI to group them into 3 main themes.
